tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250byin dbab pa ni:1$0000300 hūm̐ hrī: dus gsum rgyal sras padma thod phreng rtsal: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: dpa' bo dpa' mo dam can rgya mtsho rnams: kun kyang ye nas chos sku skye med las: sprul bsgyur gzugs skus 'gro don mdzad pa'i phyir: thugs dam rgyud bskul dbyings nas sku bzhengs 'tshal: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: chos kyi dbyings nas 'gro don skur sprul la: rnal 'byor mched lcam rig 'dzin sgrub pa pos: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob bya'i phyir: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro srung ma'i tshogs: sprul pa yang sprul 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: rdzu 'phrul mkha' la sprin ltar gtibs nas kyang: byin rlabs mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams: g.yel ba med par dus 'dir char ltar phob: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro srung ma'i tshogs: mdzad pa'i rnam thar cho 'phrul bsam mi khyab: sprul pa yang sprul dhā ki pho nyar bcas: sku yi rnam 'gyur gar stabs glog ltar 'khyug: gsung gi gdangs skad nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog: brtse ba'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs char ltar 'beb: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: dkyil 'khor gzhal yas 'di la byin gcig phob: phyi nang gsang dbang ma lus bskur du gsol: rnal 'byor sgrub mchog rnams la byin gyis rlobs: pho brang chen po 'di la brtan par bzhugs: dpal chen khyed kyi mthu rtsal nus pa phyungs: rtags dang mtshan ma ma lus bstan du gsol: mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i thugs dam dus la bab: ma g.yel ma g.yel bla ma yi dam lha: ma g.yel ma g.yel dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: rang bzhin gnas nas sku bskyod 'dir gshegs la: dbang chen khyed kyis bdag la dbang skur la: byin chen khyed kyis bdag la byin phob cig: bla ma sku yi ye shes gzi brjid che: rnal 'byor lus la bde ba bskyed du gsol:

yi dam gsung gi byin rlabs nus par ldan: sgrub pa mthar phyin dngos grub bstsal du gsol: mkha' 'gro thugs kyi dgongs pa klong du gyur: ji bsam yid bzhin 'grub par mdzad du gsol: dpal chen khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadzra gu ru padma siddhi dhe wa dhā ki nī: bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha: badzra ma hā kro dha shānti ka: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya sarba siddhi: kā ya wā ka tsitta: dzñā na satwa a mi dhe wa: ma ma tsitta saṃ bha wa a dhiṣṭha naṃ: ma ma ā yurdzñā na siddhi pha la: ā we sha ya st+waṃ bha ya ra ra ra ra tsā la ya hūm̐: āḥdzhaiṃ sa ma ya a we sha ya hriṃ hriṃ: pheṃ pheṃ: hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā:
zhes pas ye shes byin chen dbab cing dzap dang bcas pas bro gar 'khrab pa la sogs bya'o: las byang tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs las so// //
